28. Paging, Page Faults and TLB

Paging divides virtual memory into pages. A TLB caches address translations; a page fault occurs
when a translation or access needs OS handling.

Q: Does every page fault require disk I/O?
A: No. Minor faults may be resolved without disk access; invalid accesses may fail.
